name: Gemini
promptStyle: Direct actionable instructions, multimodal input references, cleanly demarcated task context, and verifiable output criteria.
principles: State task instructions concisely and directly without superfluous preamble.
Structure contextual data and user inputs with distinct headers and bullet points.
Clarify multimodal relationships (documents, diagrams, code) and desired transformations.
Provide clear negative constraints and quality benchmarks.
Distinguish empirical facts from creative inferences or assumptions.

rules.title: Direct and Concise Instructions
rules.description: Express goals with active, imperative verbs and eliminate conversational filler for maximum adherence.
rules.sourceTitle: Gemini API Prompting Strategies - Be clear and specific

rules.title: Structured Input Delineation
rules.description: Group complex input materials under descriptive headings and specify exact operations for each source.
rules.sourceTitle: Gemini API Prompting Strategies - Structure your prompt

rules.title: Explicit Acceptance Criteria
rules.description: Define measurable success criteria and precise output formatting targets.
rules.sourceTitle: Gemini API Prompting Strategies - Give examples and specify output format

contextStrategy: Organize context chunks cleanly under a dedicated 'Context & Reference Data' section with document origin headers.
outputGuidance: Specify layout structure, markdown formatting, bulleted lists, and specific sections to return.

references.title: Gemini API Prompting Strategies
